meta_description: Open-Door Lockmasters provides rapid emergency locksmith services across Leicester. Locked out? We arrive within 60 minutes. Call now for fast, affordable help.
hero_subhead: Locked out in Leicester at 2am? Our emergency team arrives within 60 minutes, any time of day or night.
services_subhead: From midnight lockouts to broken key extraction, we handle every lock emergency with speed and skill.

services.title: Emergency Lockout Callouts
services.desc: Locked out of your home, car, or office? We'll have you back inside within the hour, with no damage to your locks. Available 24/7, every day of the year.

services.title: Lock Repairs & Replacements
services.desc: Damaged locks, broken cylinders, or worn mechanisms repaired or replaced on the spot. We carry common lock types and can usually fit new locks the same day.

services.title: Broken Key Extraction
services.desc: Snapped your key inside the lock? We remove broken key fragments safely without forcing the mechanism, then cut a new key on-site.

services.title: Door & Window Lock Installation
services.desc: Upgrade your home security with new locks fitted by our team. We fit insurance-approved locks that give you peace of mind and lower premiums.

services.title: Cylinder Lock Changes
services.desc: Lost your keys or changing tenants? We'll swap out your lock cylinders in minutes, rekeying your home to new keys with no disruption.

services.title: Lock Assessment & Security Advice
services.desc: Worried about your home's security? We survey your property, identify weak points, and recommend upgrades that work within your budget.

about_pullquote: I started this after my own lockout nightmare. Now I answer the call others ignore.
about_para_1: Open-Door Lockmasters was born from frustration. The owner, locked out of his own home at midnight, couldn't find a tradesman willing to help. Eight years on, we've become Leicester's go-to emergency locksmith, handling over 500 callouts a year. Every job is treated as if it were our own front door — because we know how stressed you are.
about_para_2: We're not the cheapest, but we're the fastest and fairest. Our engineers carry stock of common locks and blanks, so most jobs are completed on your first visit. We're DBS checked, fully insured, and we stand behind every lock we touch. Your repeat business and honest reviews are how we've built trust across Leicester.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Locked myself out at midnight on a Sunday — thought I'd be in a hotel. Called Open-Door and they answered straight away. Chap arrived in under an hour, had me back in the house in five minutes flat. Charged a fair price with no hidden extras. Absolute lifesaver.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Had a broken key stuck in my front door. I was panicking but the locksmith knew exactly what to do. No damage to the lock, cut me a new key on the spot while I waited. Friendly, professional, and done in 20 minutes. Will definitely call them again if I need to.
reviews.author: Emma T.

reviews.text: Called for advice on upgrading our locks after a break-in scare. The guy didn't just flog us new locks — he looked at what we actually needed and came back the next day to fit them properly. Felt like he genuinely cared. That's rare. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael S.

address_sub: Serving all of Leicester and surrounding areas
opening_hours_sub: Open every day of the year — weekends, bank holidays, and Christmas included
emergency_banner_text: Locked out in Leicester right now? We aim to be with you within 60 minutes. Call us immediately —
footer_description: Open-Door Lockmasters is Leicester's trusted 24/7 emergency locksmith. Fast response, fair prices, DBS checked team.
